tei:div.tei:p: yum ka'i sun bzlog btang tshul ni/ las dkyil steng*/ gtor ma mkhar thabs kha bad sgo bzhi can/ de steng 'brang rgyas gtso 'khor lnga/ dbus su nam mkha' sngon po/ phyogs bzhir rang mdog rgyang bu/ mda' 'phang*/ shing ris can/ rtsod/ rgya skag zhu mkhan sogs lho rdzas/ lan tshwa/ bul tog sogs byang rdzas/ tshwa la/ la btsas rdo sogs la rdzas/ bye ma/ rgog gtsong*/ zam shing sogs klungs rdzas/ rin chen sman 'bru ci 'dzoms gdab/ snod lnga'i nang*/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg ltar/ mchog gi bla gtor zlum po dang bcas pa'i mchod gtor lnga/ snod gcig tu glud/ glud chung lo grangs/ mtheb skyu/ sha dum/ ril bu/ chang bu rnams lo grangs/ grangs bsog la stong tshar dgos pas/ glud chung stong*/ ril bu/ lan chags stong*/ tshogs shin tu gzab spros/ mchod gtor bcas/ 'don 'grigs ni/ yum ka'i bstod pa'i rjes/ sun bzlog gi phaṭaḥdzaḥ mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar= sngags stong tsam/ mchod bstod/ yig brgya/ tshe 'gugs/ hūm̐ḥ shar nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro= rgyas gdab/ āḥ 'byung lnga'i dbyings su= gsol ka/ na rag skong bshags sam/ ye shes sku mchog= rjes/ mahā shū n+ya ta= stong pa'i ngang las= dzaḥ bar/ thing gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis/ spyan 'dren/ 'jam rol/ sum gnyis/ yun ka'i tshogs/ skong bshags thol glu'i nang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ gangs can mtsho yi= tshar grangs stong 'gro dgos/ mdor na= drang*/ lhag ma/ thing*/ sil/ thing*/ tho gdangs/ kyeḥ gson cig= lan gcig sil/ dgu thing gis/ kyeḥ sun ma'i mgron rnams= de bzhin rigs kyi dar thag bsdusaḥ bar lan gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis/ rjes/ (432) glud gtor ril bu/ chang bu rnams lo grangs glud chen du dor zhing*/ hūm̐ḥ rigs lnga'i rgyal ba= phrin las mdzodaḥ bar/ grangs bsogs nas/ stong tshar 'gro dgos rgyu de yin/ de nub/ dgu thing*/ dbyings rang snang= lan gsum tsam/ bzhag lhug hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon= gzugs kyi phung po= lan gcig

gsol ka bskul/ chad brtan man/ spyi ltar ro/ grol nyin/ seng gdong*/ sgo dbye/ zor rnams la/ mdos zhes bsgyur/ shar/ shar lho/ byang shar bcas la 'dzem/ de min mkha' 'gro'i 'du tshogs dang bstun nas 'phen dgos/ las byang*/ bskul/ chad tho/ gshegs gsol/ kyaiḥ sun ma'i mgron= phrin las mdzodaḥ bar srung 'khor/ gsol ka brtan ma man spyi ltar ro// ༄༅/ yum ka'i me mchod 'don 'grigs ni/ bca' gshom rnams gzhung ltar tshogs nas/ me thab zhi ba/ dbus su baṃḥde rgyab pad 'dab bzhir ha ri ni sa yig mgo phyir bstan/ de rgyab rdo ra/ 'od phreng*/ shing zhi bar zlum po drug skor/ srad bu bres/ thabs 'geb dkar/ mda' dar dmar/ rlung g.yab/ dgang blugs/ rdzas yam shing mtho gang*/ mar khu/ til khu/ til dkar nag dkar gsum mngar gsum/ dri bzang bcas pa'i zho zan phye 'phur/ so ba/ 'bras/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ yungs dkar/ ku sha/ durba/ shing tog dar sna/ sman sna/ rin chen phye ma/ ba sha dum bu mang po la sman sgrub btab pa/ dar/ so tsi/ go yu/ thod chang*/ tshogs bcas dgos/ yum bka'i las byang*/ bsnyen pa ci nus/ las bum la dmigs/ badz+ra aṛ ta= brgya/ mchod bstod/ yig brgya/ gsol ka/ skong bshags/ tshogs lhag ma yan grub nas/ me mchod/ badz+ra a mṛ ta= āḥ chos rnams rang bzhin= spyan 'dren/ zhi rol/ mchod pa/ rol/ thob (433)par gyuraḥ rjes/ dgang blugs/ mar khu/ oṃ pad+mo= swa hā: bar bdun/ rnal 'byor pa= rol/ de 'dra gsum/ yam shing*/ oṃ pad+mo= swa hā brgya/ rnal 'byor pa= rol/ mar khu'i sngags brgya/ 'dod gsol/ rol/ rdzas sder brgyad la/ de 'dras rol re re/ des stong gcig grub/ de 'dra lan bcus khri/ de 'dras 'bum 'gro dgos/ nub mo/ badz+ra wasta/ rol/ taṃ bu= rol/ tshogs bsdus/ 'og min gnas dang= bsdus pa tshar gcig rol/ mkha' 'gro sgrub pa'i dam tshig= chad tho blang*/ rol/ byon skyems dgang blugs/ pad+mo yo gi= bdun/ rnal 'byor= rol/ de 'dra gsum/

khyed kyi sems can= mkha' 'gro ma yi= snang srid= rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i= rol/ gsol ka bkyags/ bskul chad brtan man rgyun gyi phyag bzhes ltar ro/ nyang gi khros nag sbyin sreg nang*/ sngags brgya re bsog rgyu de/ a ha ri ni sa brgya/ sbyin sreg sngags ring de brgya tshar re/ 'dod gsol rol mo byas na chog pa zhig smin gling lo chen rin po che'i gsung las snang bas de ltar mdzad na stabs bde che ba 'dra/ rdzas yam shing*/ mar khu/ rdzas spungs rim par 'bul ba las/ dgang blugs nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs/ rgyal dbang lnga pa/ smin gling lo chen sogs bka' babs rnams kyi gsung sgros dngos shugs nas mi snang bas mi dgos pa 'dra/ ༄༅/ yum ka'i rnam rgyal tshe sgrub 'don lugs ni/ bum pa/ tshe ril/ tshe chang*/ mda' dar bcas bshams/ 'don 'grigs ni/ sems bskyed sdom chog nas/ yum ka'i bstod pa yan grub mtshams/ nang sgrub las/ mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar = sogs/ gyur/ oṃ pad+mo yo gi=(434)da te bh+rūm̐ swa hāḥ brgya/ bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐ḥ dgu re la phreng rdog re bsgrangs ba'i phreng skor gcig gis dgu brgya dang stong song mtshams/ tshar dang po la yum ka'i las byang mchod bstod/ yig brgya/ phyi ma rnams la/ ye shes lha tshogs= tshe 'gugs ni/ tshe dbang mtshams sbyor ni/ hūm̐ḥ ye shes dbyings nas= tshe khug cigaḥ oṃ pad+mo yo gi= bh+rūm̐ swa hā: tshar dang po la tshig bzhi'i mtshams su re re sbrag phyi ma rnams la gter gzhung ltar las mi dgos/ phyag 'tshal de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug gtor/ bsten ma/ tshar bcu/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs nas 'di yan grangs bsog grangs rdzogs dus/ rigs 'dus tshe sgrub ltar/ āḥ 'byung lnga'i dbyings su= rak+ṣaḥ rgyas gdab bya/ tshar rjes mar/ mchod phreng man sbyar ba sngar ltar ro// zhes pad+ma ma ṇis bris pa dge legs 'phel// dge'o//
